chapter.v:
Jehovah reigneth;
he is clothed with majesty;Jehovah is clothed with strength; he hath girded himself therewith:The world also is established, that it cannot be moved.

Thy throne
is established of old:Thou art from everlasting.

The floods
have lifted up, O Jehovah,The floods have lifted up their voice;The floods lift up their waves.

Above the
voices of many waters,The mighty breakers of the sea,Jehovah on high is mighty.

Thy testimonies
are very sure:Holiness becometh thy house,O Jehovah, for evermore.
